197				logging.Warningf(msg, query)

201			logging.Warningf("unable to stat %q: %s", query, err.Error())

68	func retrievePrivatePulumiCloudTemplate(templateURL string) (workspace.TemplateRepository, error) {
69		u, err := url.Parse(templateURL)
70		if err != nil {
71			return workspace.TemplateRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("parsing template URL: %w", err)
72		}
73		// Docs convention is to store the cloud URL with the protocol.
74		// e.g. `pulumi login https://api.pulumi.com` or `pulumi login https://api.acme.org`
75		templatePulumiCloudHost := "https://" + u.Host
76	
77		account, err := workspace.GetAccount(templatePulumiCloudHost)
78		if err != nil {
79			return workspace.TemplateRepository{}, fmt.Errorf(
80				"looking up pulumi cloud backend %s: %w",
81				templatePulumiCloudHost,
82				err,
83			)
84		}
85	
86		if account.AccessToken == "" {
87			return workspace.TemplateRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("no access token found for %s", templatePulumiCloudHost)
88		}
89	
90		templateRepository, err := workspace.RetrieveZIPTemplates(templateURL, func(req *http.Request) {
91			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "token "+account.AccessToken)

97				templatePulumiCloudHost,
